setlist.title: It Must Have Been The Roses

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Alabama Getaway** (2 reviews): Played after a long absence, and Jerry fumbled some lyrics; the jam afterward was middling; Singled out as a highlight of a strong, well-played first set [20][23]
- **Walkin' Blues** (2 reviews): This track would not play for the reviewer, who used another version instead [24][25]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): Singled out as a highlight of a strong first set with Jerry on fire [23]

## Setlist highlights

- **Pre-Conference**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **Rainforest Press Conference**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **Post-Conference**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-09-14.142128.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 215 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1988-09-14.142091.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 23 songs; 215 min [2]
- **gd1988-09-14.134429.dts.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 144 min [3]
- **gd1988-09-14.134428.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 144 min [4]
- **gd88-09-14.sbd.munder-des.5573.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 139 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [13]. Said about its sound: Reviewer prefers this audience recording of the three available; it conveys the room's feel, which matters at MSG [24]
- **gd88-09-14.sbd.ashley-bertha.7488.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 139 min; rated 3.3/5 by 10 [14]. Said about its sound: This remaster is crisper than the other soundboard circulating, with very heavy, powerful bass; Bass is booming and prominent on this soundboard; Soundboard sounds like standing onstage with the band, with the boisterous crowd seeming far away [16][17][20][25]

## Around the show

- Reviewer stood on the floor just right of the soundboard and recalls shouting for more volume [19]
- Reviewer found friend Kenny, lost earlier at a gas station 80 miles from the venue [22]
- Second set seemed rushed and perfunctory, with energy dropping sharply after the break [23]
- Reviewer was the only one left from the Rochester family on the bus by this point in the tour [24]
- Reviewer was the only one left from the Rochester family on the bus by this point in the tour [25]
- At the end of this song, Jerry appears to shush Bobby so the crowd can be heard [26]
- Seen as a good start to the MSG run, solid like most of that stand [18]
- Lacked the punch of the rest of the run; the next two nights are judged far better [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-09-14.142128.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [1]. Also: The press conference comes from a different source than the concert recording; Ted Mattes supplied the patch source used in this transfer; Scott Clugston supplied the pitch correction settings; files are 16 bit at 44.1 [1]
- **gd1988-09-14.142091.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [2]. Also: The press conference comes from a different source than the concert recording; Ted Mattes supplied the patch source used in this transfer; Scott Clugston supplied the pitch correction settings for this soundboard release [2]
- **gd1988-09-14.134429.dts.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix ; SBD (shnid=5573) SBD> MC> DAT> CDR> EAC> WAV> SHN; via Nick Scarano; Nick's initial shn set was missing encore- encore track added from… [3]. Also: A DTS surround mix made by an archive.org user, converted to FLAC on 10 October 2015 [3]
- **gd1988-09-14.134428.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=5573) SBD> MC> DAT> CDR> EAC> WAV> SHN; via Nick Scarano; Nick's initial shn set was missing encore- encore track added from… [4]. Also: Matrix mix of two sources, 48% soundboard and 52% audience, made by an archive.org user [4]
- **gd88-09-14.sbd.munder-des.5573.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> MC> DAT> CDR> EAC> WAV> SHN [13]
- **gd88-09-14.sbd.ashley-bertha.7488.sbeok.shnf**: source: Jay Ashley (Bertha) remaster of original shn set [14]
